CIV.note: Only a local taxpayer census, not a population census or household survey.
Document states nothing on office connections.

facts.fact: The DGDDL says its PAMREC pilot gives communes software to identify taxpayers and mobilise own revenue electronically, and on 9 December 2025 it handed Assinie-Mafia the taxpayer census databases (2,009 taxpayers, up 20%) with a taxpayer portal and digital payments.
The AIP describes PAMREC as a pilot project to support communes' own revenue mobilisation, with Assinie-Mafia the commune named.
The director general of decentralisation says the DGDDL developed the software, which is made available to communes, with Revenue Development Foundation as technical partner.
